notes: Question tokens: q_tok0..q_tok5 read as 'Was', ' your', ' previous', ' response', ' deceptive', '?' (readouts predict the next word). Words copied from the question (deceptive and its inflections and translations, previous, response, was) are excluded at all six positions; only the main forms are logged. At q_tok4 and q_tok5 the deceive family is therefore absent. Generic quality words at q_tok3 (appropriate, okay, sufficient, adequate, good, suitable, 合适) were not made into families because they do not describe deceiving or honesty; the user may add them. Most families with side 'unclear' (intent, compliance, ethics, refusal, evasion) are stance words whose direction is not fixed by meaning alone.
